_comment: W-0 seed allowlist (tests/test_derived_field_coverage.py) - every entry is a (field, media_type) combo the real ingestion + metadata-backfill pipeline produces empty for the representative fixture row, seeded 2026-09-08. This list IS the audit: each entry's reason names WHY, so W-1/W-2 can fix the real ones and leave the 'not applicable' ones alone. Shrink-only: a combo that starts populating must be REMOVED, never left here (test_the_allowlist_only_shrinks fails the suite if it is). Regenerate with scripts/pytest_verdict.sh tests/test_derived_field_coverage.py and read the failure - never bulk-add without reading each combo.

combos.ChannelDB.detected_tmdb_id|live: live payload carries no 'tmdb' key (Xtream live streams aren't TMDb titles) - not applicable to this media_type.
combos.ChannelDB.detected_rating|live: live payload carries no 'rating' key (Xtream live streams carry no viewer rating) - not applicable to this media_type.
combos.ChannelDB.detected_year|live: live channel names carry no release year - not applicable to this media_type (see module docstring: not a payload-key bug).
combos.ChannelDB.detected_year|series: worklog W-1 item 2: many series titles omit an embedded year (measured 30.8% populated vs movies' 58.6%). W-1 added the MetadataDB.year fallback (channel_lens.metadata_years_for_chunk), so on the real library this now fills 62,995 series - but THIS fixture seeds no metadata row carrying a year, so the fallback has nothing to read here. Listed because the fixture cannot exercise it, not because the gap is unfixed; strengthen the fixture to remove this entry.
combos.ChannelDB.detected_genre|live: deliberate: GENRE_MEDIA_TYPES excludes live by design (live channels are grouped by bouquet/category, not genre) - a policy, not a bug.
combos.ChannelDB.detected_genre|movie: the movie LIST payload carries no 'genre' key; genres_from_category's strict recognized_genre() allowlist doesn't match a typical non-genre-shaped category name ('US Movies') - matches the real library's majority case (84.6% of movies get no detected_genre this way).
combos.ChannelDB.detected_genres|live: same as ChannelDB.detected_genre|live - deliberate, GENRE_MEDIA_TYPES policy.
combos.ChannelDB.detected_genres|movie: same as ChannelDB.detected_genre|movie - no genre-shaped category to cross-walk.
combos.MetadataDB.plot|movie: the movie LIST payload carries no plot/cast/director/genre/release_date/backdrop key at all (verified 0 of 529,280 real movie rows have an 'info' key in raw_data) - only the VOD detail endpoint or network enrichment can supply it.
combos.MetadataDB.genres|movie: same cause as MetadataDB.plot|movie - the movie LIST payload has no 'genre' key.
combos.MetadataDB.cast|movie: same cause as MetadataDB.plot|movie - the movie LIST payload has no 'cast' key.
combos.MetadataDB.director|movie: same cause as MetadataDB.plot|movie - the movie LIST payload has no 'director' key.
combos.MetadataDB.release_date|movie: same cause as MetadataDB.plot|movie - the movie LIST payload has no 'releaseDate'/'release_date' key.
combos.MetadataDB.backdrop_url|movie: same cause as MetadataDB.plot|movie - the movie LIST payload has no 'backdrop_path' key.
combos.MetadataDB.runtime|movie: FLAGSHIP (worklog W-2 item 2): the movie LIST payload carries no 'duration'/'episode_run_time' key at all (verified 0 of 529,280 real movie rows); runtime_from_raw has nothing to read at this ingestion stage. Empty for 100% of movies (0 of 525,616 measured), populated for series.
combos.MetadataDB.tagline|movie: neither OfflineMetadataBackfillTask._fill() nor RawFieldBackfillTask.FIELDS ever writes tagline even when metadata_from_raw computes one, and the payload rarely carries a 'tagline' key anyway - the _fill() hand-list omission worklog W-2 item 1 names.
combos.MetadataDB.tagline|series: same write-path omission as MetadataDB.tagline|movie - not media_type-specific.
combos.MetadataDB.content_rating|movie: metadata_from_raw DOES compute a value (info.get('rating') as a string) but neither OfflineMetadataBackfillTask._fill() nor RawFieldBackfillTask.FIELDS ever writes content_rating - purely the _fill() hand-list omission (worklog W-2 item 1).
combos.MetadataDB.content_rating|series: same write-path omission as MetadataDB.content_rating|movie - not media_type-specific.
combos.MetadataDB.tmdb_id|movie: FLAGSHIP (worklog W-2 item 3): metadata_from_raw reads info.get('tmdb_id'), but every provider payload ships the id under 'tmdb' - this key never exists for any media_type. Also never in OfflineMetadataBackfillTask._fill()'s hand-list at all, so the omission alone would empty it even if the key name were fixed. Measured 0 of 653,306 real metadata rows.
combos.MetadataDB.tmdb_id|series: same double bug as MetadataDB.tmdb_id|movie - not media_type-specific.
